trans-unit.source: After the Solid Waste Management and Public Cleansing Act 2007 (Act 672) came into force, all solid waste management and public cleansing works are fully implemented by the Solid Waste Management and Public Cleansing Corporation (SWCorp). However, the Department of Health and Environment, Kuala Lumpur City Hall through the Environment Division is still functioning in receiving and processing public application for solid waste collection and public cleaning services under the administrative area of ​​DBKL. In addition, DBKL is also responsible for ensure the level of cleanliness and comfort of the citizens of the city.
